top_comments.author: @JonMcLaren
top_comments.text:
Kind of silly way of explaining it. Its not running natively. Its converting from typescript to C which is run in a compiled web assembly. Same process just a different output language. 

Still cool but misleading.

top_reply.author: @elijahbuscho7715
top_reply.text: Just compile the resulting C. C just sounds like an intermediate representation in that case. TS -> C -> binary. The output file is a binary that runs natively on the machine.
